message: タマらん
Two months left until the Holy Night Festival.
I came down here hoping that checking out the decorations in the Shiokumi Shopping District might give me some ideas for setting the right mood.
Looks like I got a little too ahead of myself, though... It's still too early for Christmas illuminations.
In fact, today is--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello there, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte. You came out here too, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Meat or chicken♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today is Halloween!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chant the magic words and, lo and behold! Grown-ups will fall over themselves to gift you sweets!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just a moment ago, Auntie Shina gave me some simmered kabocha squash. It was delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that even count as sweets?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, angel, you were tryin' to say 'Trick or treat,' right? 'Cause 'or' is the only part you got right.」

name: Paqy
message: 「On top of that, you even messed up the phrase you confused it with. It's not 'meat or chicken,' it's 'beef or chicke--'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah-pff!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda, are you taking a nap?」
Amidst the bustling crowd, Paqy was sniped with pinpoint accuracy.
T-That has to be Riesling, right?
Am I in her crosshairs too, targeted with bullets that leave no external wounds or fatal injuries, yet hurt enough to knock you out cold?
T-This is a warning not to correct Lolotte.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, I see! Mr. Panda was saying some strange things, so he must have been talking in his sleep.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawah!! I got the magic words wrong!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah! That's right, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will check my guidebook again.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, Paqy just said the right answer a second--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, it was listed! Clap, clap, clap.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Dead or Alive♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Wroooong!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hmph!」
The manhole cover pops open, and Riesling springs out while spinning round and round.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sigh... Jiiya, you're always so cool.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave Milady's blank-blank to this humble butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's 'blank-blank' supposed to mean?」

name: Riesling
message: 「My sincerest apologies. Nothing came to mind at the moment.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Rather than having everything taught to her by others, Milady investigates matters herself... I merely wished to respect that admirable ambition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, fair enough, it is hard to sum up in one word.」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is that, and this is this.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you pointing the barrel at me!?」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, why are you using a revolver today of all days instead of your usual automatic pistol--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because Milady desires 'Dead or Alive'...」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is 'One or Eight'」
Riesling casually gives the revolver's cylinder a spin.

name: Lolotte
message: 「'One or eight'--meaning to leave your fate to the heavens and give it a try. Thrilling, thrilling.」
In a rare turn, Lolotte recites the exact proverb and its meaning. As president and her upperclassman, I'd love to praise her, but now is hardly the time.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't cock the hammer! Don't pull the trigger leaving it up to luck!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, I'm saved.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Merely a jest. As you can see, not a single bullet is loaded.」
「Porkala!?」
A bullet fires cleanly, striking a pretty-boy who just happened to be hitting on girls in the Shiokumi Shopping District.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, you can be such a scatterbrain, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave any careless blunders outside of guarding milady to this humble butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not true at all. Aside from being a bodyguard, your cooking is completely flawless too, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am humbled.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Tonight, Jiiya is going to make pumpkin pudding for me. Would you like to come over to my house and eat some together?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, thanks for the invite. I've got some errands to run though, so I can't make it. Sorry.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all! Actually, I'm rather happy that my share won't get any smaller♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, Mr. President, Mr. Panda. Good day to you.」
Lolotte and Riesling stride briskly away.
Glancing over, the person who had been felled by a stray bullet moments ago had vanished without a trace.
I'll save strolling around the Shiokumi Shopping District for another time.
